relations.note: Nanahuatzin becomes the solar body Tonatiuh after entering the divine fire.
Tecuciztecatl retreats four times, follows Nanahuatzin into the fire, then becomes the diminished Moon.
Metztli performs penance after Nanahuatl and falls into the ashes rather than the fire.
With Xiuhteuctli, Tonacateuctli commissions Nanahuatl to sustain heaven and earth.
With Tonacacihuatl, Tonacateuctli seats and adorns Nanahuatl after his solar transformation.
With Tonacateuctli, Xiuhteuctli commissions Nanahuatl for the solar task.
With Tonacateuctli, Tonacacihuatl receives, seats, and adorns the risen Nanahuatl.
Oxomoco and Cipactonal divine that Nanahuatl can strike open Tonacatepetl.
Cipactonal and Oxomoco divine that Nanahuatl can strike open Tonacatepetl.
The Tlaloque seize or distribute the foods released when Nanahuatl strikes the Food-Mountain.
Tlahuizcalpanteuctli shoots at the motionless Sun; Nanahuatl shoots back and strikes his face.
Nanahuatl's answering shot changes or disables Tlahuizcalpanteuctli after the dawn lord's attack.

relations.myth: Sacrifice of the gods at Teotihuacan
relations.note: Tezcatlipoca joins the council and collective death demanded by Nanahuatl as the motionless Sun.

relations.myth: Sacrifice of the gods at Teotihuacan
relations.note: Huitzilopochtli participates in the divine assembly and collective death demanded by the Sun.

relations.myth: Sacrifice of the gods at Teotihuacan
relations.note: Xochiquetzal participates in the divine assembly and collective death demanded by the Sun.
Xochiquetzal is Nanahuatl's foster-mother in the variant genealogy.

relations.myth: Sacrifice of the gods at Teotihuacan
relations.note: Yapaliicue participates in the assembly and collective death demanded by the Sun.

relations.myth: Sacrifice of the gods at Teotihuacan
relations.note: Nochpalliicue participates in the assembly and collective death demanded by the Sun.
Ehecatl correctly anticipates that Nanahuatzin will rise in the east.
After sacrificing the gods, Ehecatl blows Nanahuatzin as the Sun into motion.
Ehecatl and other gods select Nanahuatl to become the Sun.
Modern syntheses propose Quetzalcoatl-Nanahuatl, but the dossier says no stable ancient fusion is demonstrated.
relations.source: Modern readings of Histoyre du Mechique

relations.note: Xolotl evades the death demanded by Nanahuatzin-as-Sun through transformations but is eventually killed.
Seler and later writers propose a Nanahuatzin-Xolotl fusion, but the identification remains disputed.
Eagle enters or approaches the fire after Nanahuatzin and the lunar candidate and becomes scorched.
Jaguar follows Eagle into or near the fire after the candidates and becomes spotted or scorched.
Itzpapalotl is Nanahuatl's mother or progenitor in one transmitted genealogical strand.
Some passages or translations ambiguously transmit Cozcamiauh or Tonantzin as Nanahuatl's mother.
Piltzintecuhtli is Nanahuatl's foster-father in the variant genealogy.
Xochipilli belongs to Nanahuatl's foster household and is often described as his foster-brother.

other_aliases: Old Woman of the Metal Teeth
relations.note: Tlantepozilamatl raises or guards Nanahuatl and associated children before conflict over her diversion of food.
